name: The Crooked Mile
region_detail: Beside an abandoned timber road branching from a frequently used woodland freight route.
site_type: hideout | Faction strongholds; abandoned infrastructure | Temporary Rattleknife encampment and roadside ambush site.
history: An older timber road followed a winding course through a shallow wooded ravine before joining the principal freight route. After logging shifted elsewhere, the road and its small equipment yard were abandoned. Rattleknife brigands subsequently discovered that altered trail markers could divert unfamiliar wagoners toward the ravine.
current_state: A Rattleknife detachment intermittently occupies the old equipment yard and uses the surrounding woodland to conceal stolen goods. False trail markers remain in circulation along nearby roads. The brigands move between several camps and may abandon the site when their activities draw attention.
inhabitants: Intermittent Rattleknife goblins; pack animals when available; woodland wildlife. The number and identity of the brigands present vary.
danger_level: Moderate when occupied; low to moderate when abandoned, depending on remaining traps or hazards.
points_of_interest:
False trail markers; abandoned equipment yard; broken timber racks; brush shelters; concealed goods caches; old wagon ruts; lesser trails leading away from the ravine.

Unresolved elements: Which detachment occupies the camp at the time of discovery; The fate and whereabouts of the diverted wagons and their cargoes; Whether local guides or others have assisted the brigands; The subsequent use of the abandoned road if the camp is dispersed.
discovery: Beside an abandoned timber road branching from a frequently used woodland freight route. Wagoners reporting misleading trail markers may identify the relevant junction. Local guides or a recovered piece of stolen freight may provide further clues.
